gen-gf-warnes-gf-sen: Stretched, splashy and loud, Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they touch. Sen is a plain sans with tall lowercase, so give it a generous size and it stays easy to take in.
gen-righteous-fs-technor: Playful, with a steel-rod swagger in every bowl of Righteous. Technor has neon-tube lines of one thickness and a wide channel into each bowl, which makes the pair feel like a cool glowing sign.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-snippet: Confident Oswald packs its rows of text tightly, while Snippet's wire-bent letters and wide crescent c feel more approachable. One hits hard; the other eases in.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-amarna: Amarna reads as a plain sans with contrast-free strokes and small counters that never clog, so text stays crisp. Chubbo's marker-tip casualness is the pair's real charm.
gen-almendra-display-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and its mean line high, giving a modern, uniform texture under the ornate Almendra Display. Give the body a little extra size.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line of constant width, with daylight inside every curve and no calligraphic modulation at all. And ZCOOL XiaoWei, a clean sans with moderate stroke contrast, feels softer and more written beside it.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-andika: Andika has tails and terminals as thick as its main stems. Its wide, easy s turns meet Chubbo's marker-tip looseness, and the shared friendliness is what holds this pair together.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-source-sans-3: Tight, tall and tough, Oswald packs its rows hard against a sans body with an a that opens to breathe. Source Sans 3 should read smoothly and without strain over pages.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-zen-kaku-gothi: Marker-line boldness with daylight in every curve, that's Red Hat Display up top, with Zen Kaku Gothic New below it. Its open-mouthed curves and lack of swells make the pair feel unfussy.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-anta: Chubbo draws loose, marker-tip letters with smooth paths around every bend, so the headline feels casual and inviting. Anta answers with wire-bent, constant-thickness shapes and gaping mouths on the e, a tidier, more engineered partner.
